lines.text: Moses tells Israel the LORD their God will cross the Jordan ahead of them as a consuming fire.
Moses says the LORD drives out the nations because of their wickedness, not Israel's righteousness, for Israel is stiff-necked.
Moses stayed on Mount Sinai forty days and forty nights, then received tablets inscribed by Joshua.

wrong_details.true: Horeb is named as the place of provoking, and the mountain where he received the tablets; the walkthrough taught Horeb
tablets inscribed by the finger of God

lines.text: Moses came down, threw the tablets and shattered them, then burned the calf and ground it to dust.
Moses made an ark of acacia wood and kept the new tablets in his tent.

wrong_details.wrong: kept the new tablets in his tent
wrong_details.true: placed the tablets in the ark he had made
